control_device_fabrication: A methodical exploration of fabrication parameters ensured the perovskite cell was constituted, translating each controlled variable into a PCE of 14.979%, FF of 75.357%, Voc of 1.0221 V, and Jsc of 19.448 mA/cm². The perovskite precursor solution (1.73 mol/L) was prepared in mixed solvents of DMF and DMSO according to chemical formula of Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1. The SAM material MeO-4PADBC (0.33 mg/mL) was introduced to enhance interfacial properties and improve device performance.  The perovskite precursor was spin-coated onto substrates with two stages program at 1000 rpm for 10 s, and 5000 rpm for 30 s, respectively. By delivering 160 µL of antisolvent at last 6 s, the final film exhibited improved surface coverage and reduced pinholes. Subsequently, the sample was annealed at 110 °C for 25 min.
target_device_fabrication: The champion device fabricated by perovskite film showed a PCE of 15.5773% with open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.92251 V, short current density (JSC) of 24.0394 mA/cm², and a fill factor (FF) of 70.2419%. The perovskite precursor solution with a molar concentration of 1.73 mol/L was prepared according to the formula of Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1. A SAM consisting of MeO-4PADBC (0.33 mg/mL) was incorporated to achieve a more uniform and well-ordered perovskite interface. MACl additive was added into the precursor solution at a concentration of 8.5 mg/mL. The precursor solution was spin-coated in a two-step process at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s, respectively. During the second spin-coating step, 160 µL of antisolvent was introduced at last 6 s. The films were then annealed at 110 °C for 25 min.
